name: Mariscos El Titanic
notes: Router flagged no-platform (this is a .shop domain, checked per rule for farm tells: it does NOT redirect to another registrable domain, so per playbook it is treated as the restaurant's own site, not a farm). Address on page (3600 Fairmount Ave, San Diego, CA 92105) matches work list exactly. Site is a single-page-per-section builder (12 menu sections + Others). Dropped 11 unpriced rows (empty <span class="dish--price"> - includes a set of unpriced novelty cocktail names Viagra/Masoquista/Matapasion/Dormilona/Torturadora/Locochona under "Seafood", Pescado Zarandeado, Shrimp Fajitas, Filete Dicaprio, and 7 items under "Others" that are just an index/repeat-list of dishes already priced elsewhere plus a 8 seafood-fountain platter). Cent distribution over 116 priced rows: .00 (52), .75 (23), .50 (22), .95 (11), .25 (8) - 100% conventional endings, no markup shape. Price level (tacos .75-4.75, botana platters 8-28, camarones entrees 4.95-18.50, fish fillets 8-23, 8 party fountain) is internally corroborated by an on-page customer review stating prices run "around 4 a plate", matching Filete Don Hector/Relleno De Mariscos/Huachinango all at 3. Homepage marketing copy reads as AI-generated SEO filler (noted per playbook farm-tell caution) but the menu page itself is clean structured first-party HTML (h3 dish--title / span dish--price pairs), distinct from the garbled-directory-farm pattern.

Name

Dropped 2 rows with genuinely empty price spans (Heineken, Pacifico bottles under Bar - Bottles & Cans, no price printed anywhere for them). 4 sections (Happy Hour Wine/ Drafts/2 Craft Cocktails, Five Days Ways) print their flat price in the SECTION NAME itself rather than per item (every item's is empty) - used that printed flat price for each item in those sections (18 rows) rather than treating them as unpriced, since the number is directly on the page, not inferred. Price level (breakfast 6-22, lunch sandwiches 6-19, dinner entrees 4-42, cocktails 2-17, dessert -10) is plausible for a 2026 Mission Bay resort restaurant. Sections reached: all of the above; no dessert/catering-only adjunct pages included (Event Catering Menu excluded as an adjunct).
